changelog.notes: Released, after an independent audit of every card against its source.

Cards that rested on scrum.org pages, which had been read through a proxy reader against scrum.org’s terms, were reworked. 9 were re-sourced to the Evidence-Based Management Guide or the Scrum Guide with a quote from it: the Mission Statement and Vision Statement cards now use the EBM Guide’s definitions, and the forecast and self-management primers rest on the Scrum Guide. 43 were retired because no open guide states their fact, which ends cover of stakeholder kinds, customers, Product Value, Product Vision, Business Strategy, release planning and the benefits of small releases. One more card that also cited scrum.org now rests on the Scrum Guide alone.

checks.what: An independent audit read all 307 cards: the 255 that quote the Scrum, Evidence-Based Management and Nexus Guides against their quotes, which the card checker found word for word, and the 52 written in our own words against the saved scrum.org pages
checks.result: No wrong answers; 2 unsupported claims, 1 ambiguous card, 2 unclear ones and 7 minor issues were fixed.

checks.what: The 53 cards that cited scrum.org pages were compared with the Scrum Guide 2020, the Evidence-Based Management Guide 2024 and the Nexus Guide 2021
checks.result: 10 cards were rewritten from those guides and their quotes found word for word by the card checker; 43 whose fact no open guide states were retired.
